name: Reference / Evidence Resolution Engine
purpose: Resolve multiple machine-readable evidence references into one deterministic authoritative evidence view without mutating state or executing actions.
forbidden: use chat history as authoritative truth
convert stale evidence into current evidence

deep_audit.01_purpose: Resolve evidence identity, authority, freshness and conflicts.
deep_audit.02_capability_completeness: Reference validation, deterministic ranking, conflict detection, freshness detection and authoritative selection.
deep_audit.03_inputs: Typed evidence references and resolution request.
deep_audit.04_outputs: Resolved evidence set and deterministic resolution fingerprint.
deep_audit.05_state_dependency: Canonical state evidence is consumed read-only.
deep_audit.06_evidence_dependency: T03, T12, T17, T18, T19, T20, T21 and T22 evidence.
deep_audit.09_failure_modes: Missing evidence, invalid identity, stale evidence, contradictory authoritative evidence and integrity mismatch.
deep_audit.11_determinism: Ranking and resolution use explicit authority and deterministic tie-breaking.
deep_audit.12_concurrency: Resolution store rejects incompatible duplicate identities.
deep_audit.13_recovery: Ambiguous evidence fails closed rather than guessing.
deep_audit.14_gpt_limitation_coverage: Prevents stale context, memory assumptions and unsupported reference selection.
deep_audit.15_new_agent_usability: Resolution result contains all selected and rejected evidence identities.
deep_audit.16_cross_chat_continuity: Evidence fingerprints allow the same truth set to be reconstructed in another chat.
deep_audit.17_read_capability: Reads supplied evidence references and immutable metadata.
deep_audit.18_write_capability: Only internal resolution evidence registration; no project-state writes.
deep_audit.19_testability: Pure deterministic evidence objects support isolated tests.
deep_audit.20_observability: Authority, status, ranking, conflicts and fingerprints are exposed.
deep_audit.21_integration_contract: Upstream evidence becomes one deterministic resolved evidence view.
deep_audit.22_missing_layers: Continuity recovery, budgeting, scheduling, reconciliation and execution remain downstream.
deep_audit.23_authority_permission_boundary: T23 never creates or upgrades authority.
deep_audit.24_idempotency_replay_safety: Same evidence set and resolution request produce the same resolution fingerprint.
deep_audit.25_versioning_migration_compatibility: Schema and policy versions are explicit.
deep_audit.26_adversarial_red_team_coverage: Fake authority, duplicate identity, stale evidence, conflicting evidence and fingerprint substitution are blocked.
